 Samsung Lions 7-8 KT Wiz in Korean Series Game 1 — as it happened
 The Suwon club gave up a whopping 8-run lead in the seventh inning to turn a lopsided start to th series into a dramatic nailbiter down to the last pitch.
 KT Wiz players celebrating their win over the Samsung Lions in the first game in the best-of-seven Korean Series at Suwon KT Wiz Park in Suwon, Gyeonggi, on Nov. 3.
